name: Uriel
role: TFAH literary character (Milton's Paradise Lost) -- angel who watches over the Sun; deceived by Satan disguised as a lesser angel.
description: TFAH literary character. Category B, non-canonical: not named in the Protestant or Catholic biblical canon; a major figure in the pseudepigraphal 1 Enoch and 2 Esdras. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §V.
narrative_function: Deceived by Satan disguised as a cherub in Book III, unwittingly directing him to Eden.
